meta.name: clarify
meta.description: MANDATORY before any implementation when request is vague or has multiple interpretations. Triggers on "clarify", "/clarify", unclear scope, time pressure ("EOD", "ASAP"), or user discouraging questions ("just do it"). If you're about to assume something, STOP and use this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常接到模糊需求需要先澄清
copy.tagline_en: Clarify vague requirements before starting work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often receive ambiguous requests and need to clarify them first

howto.what: 当用户给出模糊或多义的需求时，Claude会暂停执行，启动强制澄清流程：先检查需求是否明确，再通过一次一个的结构化提问，将模糊请求转化为具体可执行的规范。
howto.when: 当用户需求模糊、存在多种解读，或用户使用了“clarify”、“/clarify”，或包含时间压力词（如EOD、ASAP），或用户说“just do it”时触发。

say.text: 请帮我澄清需求，区分用户认证和授权。
say.note: 触发clarify技能，Claude会开始澄清流程。

say.text: 我们需要一个登录功能，但具体安全要求是什么？
项目截止时间是EOD，但需求不明确，请先明确范围。
say.note: 在时间压力下仍执行澄清。

howto.what_en: When the user gives a vague or ambiguous request, Claude pauses execution and initiates a mandatory clarification process: first checking if the request is clear, then asking structured questions one at a time to convert the vague request into a concrete, actionable specification.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user's request is vague or has multiple interpretations, or when the user says "clarify", "/clarify", uses time pressure words (e.g., EOD, ASAP), or says "just do it".

say_en.text: Please help me clarify the requirements, distinguish user authentication and authorization.
say_en.note: Triggers the clarify skill, Claude starts the process.

say_en.text: We need a login feature, but what are the specific security requirements?
The project deadline is EOD, but requirements are unclear; please clarify the scope first.
say_en.note: Still executes clarification under time pressure.
